headline: Bottom-half Ferris State beats the table's leaders
dek: Ferris State drew at Wayne State and then went back and won there, handing the leaders only their second defeat of the season. A win at Wisconsin-Parkside and a draw with Saginaw Valley State followed, from a side that sits in the table's bottom half.
